content.title: Phoenix Criminal Defense & Personal Injury Lawyers
content.text: At Suzuki Law Offices, we’ve built our reputation on defending good people facing serious criminal charges. As trusted Phoenix criminal defense lawyers, we move quickly to protect your rights and your future, whether you’re under investigation or already arrested. Founding attorney RJ Suzuki is both a former AZ state and Federal Prosecutor. As a former Deputy Maricopa Country Attorney and Assistant U.S.Attorney, Suzuki provides a unique advantage when navigating the justice system. From DUI to white-collar crimes, we offer clear communication, strategic defense, and nonjudgmental support during life’s most stressful moments. Defending Your Freedom With Experience and Integrity Our team includes former law enforcement investigators who understand how the other side builds a case. That insight allows us to challenge weak evidence, uncover procedural errors, and fight for reduced charges or dismissals. We treat every client with dignity, keep you informed at every step, and make ourselves available 24/7 because we know your future is on the line. AWARDS & RECOGNITIONS PRACTICE AREAS Federal Crimes If you’re facing federal charges, you need an experienced advocate who can protect your rights and be your advocate under federal law. At Suzuki Law Offices, our Federal Crimes Defense Lawyer in Phoenix, RJ Suzuki, is a former Assistant U.S. Attorney with decades of experience defending individuals against serious charges. We’re here to provide the calm, steady guidance you need. Our Phoenix criminal defense lawyers handle a wide range of federal cases, including drug trafficking, money laundering, racketeering, and white collar crimes like mail or wire fraud. More on Federal Crime When The Unthinkable Happensyou need Suzuki Law What kind of support can I expect if I’m facing criminal charges? Being charged with a crime is overwhelming. At Suzuki Law Offices, we provide calm, confident guidance from the moment you reach out. As experienced Phoenix criminal defense lawyers, we act quickly to protect your rights, explain your options, and begin building a defense strategy tailored to your situation. Our team treats you with respect, keeps communication open, and works hard to reduce or dismiss the charges you’re facing. With a former federal prosecutor leading your case and former law enforcement investigators on staff, you’ll have experience and insight on your side from day one. What should I do if I’ve been arrested in Arizona? Stay calm and ask to speak with a lawyer immediately. You have the right to remain silent, and using that right can prevent serious mistakes early in your case. Once you contact the attorneys at Suzuki Law Offices, we step in to represent you during questioning, court appearances, and negotiations. The earlier we get involved, the more options we have to protect your freedom. Do I really need a Phoenix criminal defense lawyer for misdemeanor or first-time charges? Yes. Even a first offense can lead to jail time, probation, fines, or a permanent criminal record. These consequences can affect your job, housing, and future opportunities. A skilled criminal defense lawyer can identify weaknesses in the case against you and negotiate for reduced penalties or dismissal. We’re here to protect your rights, no matter the severity of the charge. How much does it cost to hire a criminal defense attorney? Costs can vary depending on the complexity of your case, the charges involved, and whether the case goes to trial. At Suzuki Law Offices, we believe in transparent, upfront pricing so there are no surprises. During your consultation, we’ll explain our fee structure clearly and walk you through what to expect. Our priority is to provide strong representation with integrity and clear communication. How long does a criminal case take to resolve? The timeline depends on many factors, including the type of charges, whether you’re facing state or federal prosecution, and how the court schedules your hearings. Some cases resolve in weeks, while others may take several months. We keep you informed at every stage and move quickly to gather evidence, file motions, and advocate for the best possible outcome.
